---
title: "Deck Title"
subtitle: "Subtitle"
date: "Month Year"
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: [default, themes/plain.scss]
    # theme: [default, themes/plain.scss, themes/editing-guide.scss]   # dashed 16:9 canvas outline while editing
    width: 1244      # 16:9 with height 700. Change BOTH or NEITHER: this pair
    height: 700      # is the authored canvas; all content is laid out against it.
    margin: 0.02     # viewport fraction kept empty around the deck (uniform only)
    max-scale: 9.9   # unclamp scaling so large displays fill (default caps at 2x)
    slide-number: true
    # embed-resources: true   # turn on (or pass -M embed-resources:true)
    #                         # for the DELIVERY render: one portable html
    #                         # file, no *_files/ dependency. See README.
    # footer: "Course or event name"
    # NOTE: the footer is viewport chrome living in the margin zone. With
    # margin below ~0.04, bottom-heavy slides can collide with it. Either
    # keep margin >= 0.04 with a footer, or drop the footer.
---
